text: Wendigo Shaman are wendigo shaman creeps that can be encountered in the Northrend tileset.
The Well-Preserved Tome is a book located on an altar within the Conservatory of the Arcane at Eredath on Argus.
Wendee Lee is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Well-Used Drinking Horn is a reward from Tracking the Tideskorn: Highlands.
Westfall Brigade Marines are dwarves and humans found battling Conquest Hold Berserkers in Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.

__NOTOC__ Wesley Rockhold is the innkeeper of the Snug Harbor Inn in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. He provides basic rest and food facilities to travelers coming from around the world who are seeking to trade here. Taelia Fordragon likes asking travelers here to tell their stories, especially those from the Eastern Kingdoms. His pot of stew is legendary.
Wendy is a wolf located at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.
Well Fed Chicken is a chicken that is a part of the Tyson Sanders encounter in Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena.

and a Kul Tiran.]] Welcome Back Weekend is an occasional promotional event aimed at bringing back old players. During this time, all inactive World of Warcraft accounts are upgraded to grant returning players full access to the game and all their characters without requiring a subscription. Alongside the Welcome Back Weekend for returning players, Blizzard also offers a discount on the following Game services: Appearance Change, Character Transfer, Faction Change, Name Change, and Race Change. Welcome Back Weekend first ran for 21-24 June 2018 with a 25% discount on the listed services. It later returned for 21-24 March 2019 with the discount increased to 30%. It returned once again in 2020
Well-Oiled Chain Gauntlets are a quest reward from Operation Recombobulation.

Weed Whacking is a bonus objective offered while on the Burton Farmstead during Gadgets and Gizmos Aplenty and Stop Vining! on the Stormsong Valley storyline. The quest can be completed very quickly while on Farming Stimulator.
Wedding Crashers is a world quest offered at Whitegrove Chapel in northwest Drustvar.
The Weighty Bag of Sand is looted from the Cache of Secrets in the Hall of Golems in Dazar'alor.
The Well-Proportioned Pauldrons drop from the following members of the Proudmoore Admiralty at Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound: *Proudmoore Sentry *Proudmoore Defender *Proudmoore Infantry
Western Zeppelin Tower was Orgrimmar's western zeppelin tower in Durotar.
Wes Johnson is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Well-Fed Doctor Fish are bought from Lil' Whaley in the Shimmering Expanse.
Westfall Infantry Corpses are humans and dwarves located at Blue Sky Logging Grounds in Grizzly Hills.
Welding Torches drop from Goblin Engineers in Stormsong Valley.
Weegli's Barrel is the barrel placed by Weegli Blastfuse in Zul'Farrak in order to blow up the gate that blocks access to Chief Ukorz Sandscalp and Ruuzlu.
Wekemara is a tidal guardian located at the Spears of Azshara in Nazjatar, being summoned by Tidemistress Ethendriss.

Westwind Weald is a location in Tiragarde Sound. It consists of rugged woodland terrain in the north-western part of Tiragarde Sound, around the area of Roughneck Camp. There is a multitude of wildlife including doe and wolves.
Wees'ki is a Zandalari troll found sleeping in the Predator Pass in Zuldazar. Next to him are Vud'ka and Scooch.
Welcome to Zandalar is awarded to Horde players who complete the Zandalar introduction quest chain, from Hour of Reckoning (Horde) to We Need Each Other.
__NOTOC__ Weeping Sanya is a banshee located in Drowned Market in Nazjatar.
Wendy Cogsworth is a Mechagon mechagnome located in the Under Junk in Operation: Mechagon.
promotion image.]] Wendigo Woolies is the name given to the BlizzCon 2019 transmog set.
West Point Tower was a planned subzone in Dustwallow Marsh. It is likely to be Lost Point, which is the westernmost of Theramore's towers.
Welding Bots are spraybots located throughout Operation: Mechagon. Interacting with them will provide their buff for two hours.

The Westfall murlocs are a group of murlocs inhabiting the coasts of Longshore in Westfall. These murlocs are responsible for the deaths of those at the Westfall Lighthouse, with one of its former residents still wanting revenge. During the investigation around the deaths of the Furlbrow, Lieutenant Horatio Laine asked an adventurer to try and find a clue from the murlocs.
The Weight of Tradition is contained in various Legion caches as well as rewarded from Legion world quests.
Westguard Turret was a planned subzone in the Howling Fjord.
Wes Abbott is an artist who was the letterer for Curse of the Worgen.
Well-Oiled Plate Girdle drops from Gunker in Operation: Mechagon.
Welcome the Void is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by bringing Urjad from the void realm using Void Tear, then defeat him and Zuraal the Ascended in Seat of the Triumvirate on Mythic Difficulty.
Well Gorged is a player vs. player achievement earned by eating cooked food or feasts to become Well Fed before the Deepwind Gorge battle begins in 50 matches.
Well-Placed Steel is a conduit for assassination rogues. It drops from Hakkar the Soulflayer in De Other Side and the Tarragrue in the Sanctum of Domination.
Wenha is a vulpera sitting next to Evie and watching the two Playful Prowlers outside the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar.
Wetland Toads are toads located in Zul'jan Ruins, the Frogmarsh, and Razorjaw River in Nazmir.
Weeping Aura was an Azerite trait for all classes. It was removed from the database around the time the Battle for Azeroth beta ended.
Wedding Guests are humans located in Whitegrove Chapel in Drustvar.

Werimu the Traitor-King is a soul sometimes found next to the Bell of Rebuke in the Halls of Atonement in Revendreth. He's under the care of Caretaker Pancha. The burdens he carried with him into death were monstrous—like nothing Pancha had seen before. Because of this, he's in danger of being sent to the Maw and will only be safe once he's atoned for every one of his sins. He is familiar with dismantling rival organizations.
The Well-Worn Raider Treads are a quest reward from It's Raid Night Every Night.
Well-Honed Instincts is a conduit for druids. It drops from Globgrog in Plaguefall and the Eye of the Jailer in the Sanctum of Domination.
Weighted Chain Boots are a quest reward from Mystery of the Sarcen Stone.
Wendigo Pantaloons are a quest reward from Pilfered Supplies (quest).
Well Crafted Chain Britches are a quest reward from Deep Roots (quest).
Weed-Flattening Greatboots are a quest reward from Weed Whacker (quest).
Westfall Brigade Elites are humans located in Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.
Wellington was a planned subzone in the Tiragarde Sound. The town would have had a brewery.
Wellington Harvesters were humans located in Wellington in Tiragarde Sound.
Wellington Cellarmasters were humans located in Wellington in Tiragarde Sound.
The Weekly Gardener's Satchel was obtained from the Gardentaur in the Queen's Conservatory.
Wednesday was a Lightforged draenei located at Ruby Feast in Valdrakken. He was replaced by Chef Zab'aji during the alpha.
Weighted Sac of Swog Treasures can be obtained from The Great Swog for 1 Silver Coin of the Isles.
Well Supplied is a reputation achievement earned by unlocking every talent in the Expedition Supplies tree.
Welcome to the Assembly introduces players to the Cobalt Assembly at the Cobalt Assembly in north-central Azure Span.

Well-Earned Victory concludes the second portion of the "The Spark of Ingenuity" quest line. This quest was originally unlocked the week of 2022-12-13, and the follow-up was unlocked the week of 2023-01-03.
Well Insulated Mug is located at Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores. Only alchemists with 25 points in Dragon Isles alchemy may interact with it.
Well-Danced Drum is located at the Filled Bowl in Iskaara, Azure Span. Only leatherworkers with 25 points in Dragon Isles leatherworking may interact with it.
Well-Worn Grimskull Cinch can be purchased at the Trading Post for 100 Trader's Tender. It first appeared in May 2023.

:"Strange winds blow in from another world, and heroes are filled with renewed vigor. Characters gain increased experience and reputation during this event. Welcome to Sanctuary was a world event celebrating the launch of the most recent installment in the Diablo franchise, Diablo IV. The event lasted for four weeks, running from June 14 - July 11, 2023. It was preceded by A Greedy Emissary, which ended the day before. Characters gained 50% increase in experience and reputation earned by virtue of the Winds of Sanctuary buff. The Loamm Niffen faction was excluded from benefitting from this.

Webwinder Weave Challenge: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Kalimdor Webwinder Weave Challenge.

Webwinder Weave Reverse Challenge: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Webwinder Weave Reverse Challenge.

Characters that are applicable for this service will have a "" text on the character selection screen where the location is usually. It functions similarly to the Character Boost, but without boosting the character's level. *Players will be able to select the specialization they'd wish to have for the character at the start and receive gear appropriate for the specialization, 4x , and Adventurer's Footlocker which contains the other specialization weapons. *Any previously worn gear and bags will be sent to the character via mail. *They'll be telepor

Well Crafted Staff is a quest reward from Bring Me Kel'gash's Head!.

[[File:Wei Wang ArtStation.jpg|thumb|Wei Wang's [https://www.artstation.com/artist/weiwangart ArtStation] profile picture.]] Wei Wang (alias Glowei) is an artist who worked for Blizzard Entertainment and was the eighth "Son" of Sons of the Storm. He joined Blizzard after he met Mike Morhaime in China and showed him his portfolio. Wei Wang is most notably famous for having realized the majority of the most iconic artwork for World of Warcraft, such as expansion box cover art, race leader loading screens, and content patch artwork. He also created art for many World of Warcraft Trading Card Game cards, some of which have also been used for Hearthstone, and served as a cinematic artist for Hear

Whales are large sea mammals. The main whale featured in Warcraft is the orca. Whales produce Greasy Whale Milk. A Whale Statue can be found in Bag of Fishing Treasures. The fish-like kraken might be whales, but those seem to be some kind of amalgamation of various aquatic creatures and not strictly whales or fish. Despite their name, whale sharks are sharks, not whales.

Whelgar's Excavation Site lies east of Menethil Harbor and southwest of Dun Modr in the Wetlands. Once a peaceful dwarven digsite, it was overrun by mottled raptors. A small group of dwarves once resided here, trapped on a ridge overlooking the dig site, but they have since abandoned the site and evacuated to the nearby Whelgar's Retreat, where they set up a camp just off the main road. Paleolithic Elementals and Living Fossils, as well as the named Sarltooth (formerly alive and a quest objective, now a rare spawn), roam the area.
What Tomorrow Brings starts The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
Whipper Root Tuber is a special consumable received from Whipper Root plants of Felwood.
Wetlands Crocolisks are crocolisks found in the Wetlands. Colored blue-green.
__NOTOC__ Wharfmaster Lozgil is a goblin quest giver located in Booty Bay of the Cape of Stranglethorn. According to him, he sees a lot of interesting characters coming and going into Booty Bay.

The Dreadsteed was previously only available to a Warlock who completed a long quest chain (of which this is a part), but was changed in patch 3.0.3 to be available to all warlocks at level 61 from the mount trainer.
You've done a lot for the Cenarion Expedition. Could you do one more thing for us?

Whelpscale Gauntlets are gloves itemized for shamans. Its name seems to suggest it has been made from scales of the black dragonkin. The fact that this gauntlets are given as a reward for a quest to kill dragons seems more evidence.
Samia wants you to capture Whelps of the Wyrmcult so she can study them.
This quest has been removed and replaced with a similar version, to see the blood elf guitar player in the band, Lvl 70 elite tauren chieftains.

Where Wyverns Dare is chapter 6 of the Invasion of Kalimdor campaign. It was the culmination of the battle between the Horde under Thrall and Jaina Proudmoore's forces for control of Stonetalon Peak and the oracle who lay within. In the Reforged remaster, the stage is renamed to Where Wind Riders Dare.
Wexford was a paladin of the Silver Hand under Duncan Senturus's command.

This breadcrumb quest leads the player to discover a Scourge plot to bolster the ranks of its army with murlocs. Both the Horde and the Alliance have this questline, but the Horde version has no introduction.
The Whalehunter Cuffs were a quest reward from Preparing for the Worst during the Wrath of the Lich King beta.
Whalehunter Leggings is a quest reward from Leading the Ancestors Home.
Whatever it Takes! is one of the concluding parts of the Sons of Hodir quest chain.
Whelp Bone Dust drops from Frostbrood Whelps at Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown.

What a Long, Strange Trip It's Been is an achievement. If you are highly active in all of the seasonal world events — Lunar Festival, Love is in the Air, Noblegarden, Children's Week, Midsummer, Brewfest, Hallow's End, and Winter Veil — you will gain as well as a rare mount, Reins of the Violet Proto-Drake. This achievement takes the longest amount of time to complete, requiring at least a year to complete all of the prerequisites.
Whale Statue can be found inside the Bag of Fishing Treasures (Dalaran) rewarded from completing Marcia Chase's daily fishing quests in Dalaran.
Whip-Stitched Wristguards are quest reward from Dun-da-Dun-tah!
What the Eck? is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Gal'darah in Gundrak on Heroic difficulty while under the effects of Eck Residue.
In order to be eligible for this quest, players are required to have earned the achievement .
Whimsical Skull Mask is sold by during the Day of the Dead. It is meant to be added to your transmogrification appearances, and only works during the holiday.
Whelk Shell Shoulderguards is a quest reward from Girding Our Loins.
__NOTOC__ Whale Sharks are gigantic boss-level sharks patrolling in the waters of Vashj'ir.
What Does 'The End of All Things' Mean for Me? is a quest item for Prophecies Of Doom.
__NOTOC__ Whiptail is a herb found in Tol Barad and along river banks in Uldum. Oasis Moths prefer to feed on Whiptail nectar.

The Wetlands storyline takes place after the Loch Modan storyline for level 20-25 Alliance players, typically dwarves and gnomes. It begins in Dun Algaz near the border with Dun Morogh and proceeds to Slabchisel's Survey where Forba Slabchisel will provide transportation all the way to Menethil Harbor. From there the quests progress to the newly upgraded Swiftgear Station along the coast to Whelgar's Retreat, Greenwarden's Grove and finally Dun Modr along the Thandol Span. The last quests in the zone bring the player into the Arathi Highlands. The progress of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Wetlands Quests. After the Wetlands comes the Arathi Highlands storyline.

Whelgar's Retreat is a dwarven outpost in the Wetlands on a hill outside the Whelgar Excavation Site. Prospector Whelgar and his crew are searching for artifacts and fossils in the excavation site at the behest of the Explorer's League. Formerly operating out of a cave overlooking the dig site, they were forced to relocate to the Retreat following the Cataclysm's earthquakes and subsequent earth elemental invasion and reanimation of fossilized dinosaurs. The Retreat happens to be dangerously close to a Dragonmaw Clan encampment, which worries the Prospector. Two paths lead to the camp, from the east and west. The western path leading here is off the road from Menethil Harbor around . It is m

Whilsey Bottomtooth is the fishing trainer for the worgen, found along the coastline in a boat near Stormglen Village in Gilneas. To get to him, worgen can enter the spider-infested half of the village, skirting the wall along the coast until they come to a small grave site at a break in the perimeter. Whilsey is just down the hill from there.
Whipping Winds are air elementals found in the Vortex Pinnacle.
Whetstone is a grummle located at the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit.

Wharf Rat can be found at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn, and Rustberg Village on Tol Barad Peninsula.

Wheezy is a gnome located in Brawl'gar Arena and Bizmo's Brawlpub as part of the Leper Gnome Quintet encounter.
What is Best in Life? is a player vs. player achievement earned for earning 8,000 Victory Point in Temple of Kotmogu.

When in Ihgaluk, Do as the Skumblade Do is a quest achievement earned for /bowing before all four forms of a Kroshik devilsaur in Ihgaluk Crag on the Isle of Thunder. Kroshik advances through four phases of life during two weeks time. It will first be found inside an egg on top of Ihgaluk Crag at Progenitus' spawn position. A day or so later, the baby Kroshik will hatch from the egg and can be found running all over the crag. A few days later, Kroshik matures to its adult form and will circle the filth pit in the middle of the crag. Finally, Kroshik will be placed on the altar at the beach and sacrificed for the good of the Skumblade tribe. This achievement is required for the meta-achieveme
The Whelp Slaying Axe is a quest reward from Identifying the Brood.
The Whipshank are a family of orc brothers and sister located in the Northern Barrens. They run a caravan business through the Barrens since Orgrimmar was settled.
The Wheelhouse of Stormstout Brewery is found along the pier behind the brewery in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Where There's Pirates, There's Booty is an exploration achievement earned for finding the three pirate-themed treasure chests on Timeless Isle.
Which Came First? is a scenario achievement. Two encampments are selected at random that require the assistance of the player. To earn this achievement, the gnomes must be aided.
What Does This Button Do? is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for using Xin the Weaponmaster's secret defense mechanism against him in Mogu'shan Palace on Heroic difficulty.
Where's My Air Support? is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Commander Vo'jak after having to kill the Sik'thik Amberwing in Siege of Niuzao Temple on Heroic difficulty.

]] The What's New (internally called splash screen) panel informs players of the latest patch content additions. It can be accessed through the Game Menu, but also automatically appears on the screen upon logging when a major patch is released. The information displayed may be tailored to the character. For example, the patch 6.0.2 panel displayed the Iron Horde Incursion world event for max-level characters, while lower-level characters saw the updated character models revamp.
Where's the Mailbox? is a collections achievement awarded for acquiring a single heirloom in the heirlooms tab, the first in a series.
What A Strange, Interdimensional Trip It's Been is an achievement earned from defeating Draenor dungeon and raid bosses with Pepe accompanying you.
Where You Go, They Will Follow is an achievement earned from recruiting 10 followers.
Which Came First, the Tree or the Seed? was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion. However, it was removed prior to release.
Whipsnap is one of three snails that can be found racing around a pillar in the Stone Market in Neltharion's Lair. His racing companions are Turbax and Blaze.

What a Ripoff! is an achievement earned from completing the listed quests in Stormheim: *Eating Into Our Business *Only the Finest *Rigging the Wager *A Stone Cold Gamble *A Stack of Racks *Put It All on Red
When You're Fifteen was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 15.
Whargarble the Ill-Tempered is a lion seal located at the Brackish Coast in Drustvar.
What the Titans Knew is a book located in Guardian's Library in the Tower of Karazhan. It was found by .
Wharrgarbl is a murloc that can be encountered as a boss in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone.

The Whale's Belly is a club located in the skeletal remains of a large aquatic creature (likely a threshadon) in the middle of Tiragarde Sound. Personal Anchors can be found here for the convenience of the guests.
Whale's Belly Patrons are located in the Whale's Belly in Tiragarde Sound.
Whalgrene's Lab is an alchemy shop located in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. It is run by Elric Whalgrene.
"What Makes Us Strong" is the introductory cinematic opening theme for World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth. It depicts the Battle for Lordaeron. The cinematic was first shown at BlizzCon 2017.

What You May Regret begins the :The Pride of Kul Tiras quest chain. Players must have earned Loremaster of Kul Tiras by completing the three Kul Tiras zone storylines: A Sound Plan, Drust Do It., and Stormsong and Dance. Cyrus Crestfall in Boralus starts the chain - there are no breadcrumbs to it.

The Whipples are a family of humans which were infected with the worgen curse. They lived at the Whipple Estate in Duskwood. While never implemented in-game, it seems they would transform at night into their Rabid counterparts.
When Spirits Whisper is the first step to obtain the tauren heritage armor. To start the questline, you need to be level .
Wexle Rocketclamp is a goblin located in Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar.
The Whipple Estate was a house in Duskwood. It was owned by the Whipple family.
Wharf-Porter Cudgel is a quest reward from The Deadliest Catch.
Wetshell Matriarchs are dragon turtles located in Briny Flats in Stormsong Valley.
Wetshell Turtles are small dragon turtles located in Stormsong Valley.
Where There's a Quill... is a potential daily quest available after activating the Anima Conductor to the Eternal Forge.
What the Whispers Told Me is a tome located in Stormsong Valley.
Whipper is a seahorse located in Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.
Wharf Warden's Gloves drop from Sergeant Bainbridge in the Siege of Boralus.

What Bastion Remembered is rewarded for completing the Things Remembered world quest in Bastion and hearing the stories of all eight characters. The WQ is up semi-rarely, and the character telling their story is random. It's entirely possible to get repeat characters in subsequent attempts.
What We Ride in the Shadows is an exploration achievement earned by renting Castle Sinrunners to give you a ride to each of the following locations in Revendreth.

Whale Ripper is a world drop and is looted from Froststeel Lockbox.

Where the Wild Corgis Are is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the Prototype Pantheon after each player has petted 5 Corgis during Wild Stampede in the Sepulcher of the First Ones on Normal Difficulty or higher.

What Lies Beyond was a quest from Sorcerer Ashcrombe in Shadowfang Keep during the development of World of Warcraft. In the finished game, Ashcrombe delivers this text (with the first line slightly changed) as gossip instead.
What Can I Say? They Love Me. is a pet battle achievement earned by collecting 1750 unique pets.

What Frozen Things Do is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Eranog after finding a Frozen Portal Stone and defeating a Burning Behemoth in Vault of the Incarnates on Normal difficulty or higher.

What Are The Chances... is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the Raging Tempest in the Nokhud Offensive after striking a single player with 5 Lightning Strikes simultaneously and defeating a Storm Elemental on Mythic difficulty.

Whiskey Slim is a gnome located in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay, in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He is affiliated with the Blackwater Raiders. He previously gave the quest Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog, whereby he tasks players with locating his Pupellyverbos Port that he lost in the Hinterlands. By the time the Cataclysm comes around, Slim has obviously kept a tighter grip on his grog since he sells Crate of Pupellyverbos Port for another quest.
The color white is used in World of Warcraft in various different ways. One way is as part of the usual Blizzard color system for items (gray, white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold).
__NOTOC__ Whirring Bronze Gizmo is crafted with Engineering (125); taught by trainers.
Whirling Invaders are air elementals found in the Crystal Vale of Silithus. They spawned during the Elemental Invasions.
__NOTOC__ Whitestone Oak Lumber dropped from Goblin Woodcarvers in the Deadmines. It only dropped if one of the party members was a paladin on The Test of Righteousness (2).

The Whispering Shore is a small stretch of coast located in western Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Solliden Farmstead. While this area used to be a popular spot for fishing, it is now the site of a band of murlocs ravenously attacking anyone who wanders near. The water off the coast is cold and dark, and nothing remains of its former bounty. The fierce murloc Muad is the leader of the invaders.

The Whispering Gardens are located in northeastern Tirisfal Glades, on the hill south of Scarlet Monastery entrance. The Whiteclaw clan was an orc clan that dwelled in eastern Frostfire Ridge. It was considered to be one of the oldest and proudest of the orcish clans. Much like the neighboring Frostwolf clan, the Whiteclaws had learned to hunt alongside Frostfire Ridge's native wolves, even befriending and training them as companions, and the Whiteclaws felt an affinity toward the Frostwolves due to their many shared customs and traditions.

Whirlwind Rippers are air elementals located in northern Desolace.

The Whisper Gulch is found in the Howling Fjord, to the north of Westguard Keep. It is an eerie place that from above looks like a narrow crack in the land, overgrown with tilting trees. Inside is a chasm crisscrossed with wooden bridges, a good number of them broken and hanging limp. Mine entrances dot the canyon walls. The wind that whistles through the gulch brings sibilant whispers to the ear. The Deranged Explorers here are indicative of an unknown force where they have been working. They appear to be suffering the same affliction as the prisoners in the Saronite Mines in Icecrown.

White Pine Trading Post is a trapper post in the Grizzly Hills, just west of Solstice Village. The trapper dissident Sasha is found here. After escaping captivity, she traveled here to question Wolfcult members about the location of her kidnapped sister. She killed most of them, leaving only Anatoly alive for questioning. Although Anatoly remained adamantly silent, he was eventually convinced to talk when Sasha kidnapped his wife, Tatjana, and brought her here. In the end, Anatoly transformed into a worgen and killed Tatjana rather than give away the location of Arugal, the cult's leader. Sasha, in turn, killed Anatoly and proceeded to try and find her sister.
Whispering Winds are found in Wintergrasp. They are a good source for Crystallized Air.

The Whistle of the Venomhide Ravasaur is a quest reward from They Grow Up So Fast (Horde). This item summons the Venomhide Ravasaur. Over the period of 20 days, players can raise their baby Ravasaur to an adult, shedding one Venomhide Baby Tooth each day. Along the way, you also need to gather 20x Rugged Leather, 20x Runecloth, and . The quest is similar to the orphan's provided for Children's Week in that the baby ravasaur is a quest giver (and ender) summoned by a quest item.
Who Needs Bloodlust? (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Thorim while under the effect of Aura of Celerity on 10-player mode.

The Whitewhisker are a group of kobolds found at Coldtooth Mine. Coldtooth Mine is a storage depot for the Horde. It was once an ideal place to store extra supplies, but, with the fighting between Frostwolves the Stormpikes growing fierce, Frostwolves do not always have the spare warriors to station at the mine and protect it, so control of the mine often falls to the Alliance or to Whitewhisker kobolds.
Requires Jewelcrafting (450) and a Simple Grinder; taught by Design: Wicked Ametrine.
Whirt the All-Knowing is a human located in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran. He can provide directions for various locations in the Dalaran.

Whistling Grove is a small pocket of unscathed land located directly north of the Inferno (the Regrowth) in Mount Hyjal. Some creatures of the forest ran here seeking shelter, but now have become trapped as the flames approach. The fires drove the little bear cubs up the trees and can't get down. Keeper Taldros ran through the flames of the Inferno from the Grove of Aessina to try and save the forest creatures. Taldros pacified the bears so they do not harm those trying to help.

The White Shark tribe is a murloc tribe that lives in the village of K's'litain in southwestern Howling Fjord. The White Sharks are led by Shlur and they are an important force on the stretch of the coast closest to Valgarde. They have the more frequent dealings with surface-dwellers than many of the other murloc clans. As with all murlocs, the White Shark tribe is religious. They worship the Deep Mother, the water, and her favored children. Shamans rule the K's'litain, dictating who handles which chores and what must be done from day to day. Lilki is a member of the tribe.
The White Tiger Cub is a companion that was created for The Burning Crusade expansion, but never implemented. The ID was later reused for Ash'ana.
